Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 100: The Otoko-tachi no Kijuu Houza
Game.Overview: An action shooter with a variety of missions and stories that branch out depending on battle results and choices.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 104: The Robot Tsukurou ze! Gekitou! Robot Fight
Game.Overview:
Ken Kusakabe, a student at a technical college in Shonan, was spending his days without any purpose. His childhood friend Ai Ito asks him to join the robot research club, which is on the verge of being discontinued.
At first, Ken treats her coldly, but when he learns of the existence of the idol "Asuka Kurimiya" in the robot battle world, he then agrees to join.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 109: The Taxi 2: Untenshu wa Yappari Kimi da!
Game.Overview: The Taxi 2 is a Racing game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 110: The Toubou Prisoner: Los City Shinjitsu e no 10-jikan
Game.Overview: The Toubou Prisoner is a sandbox game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 112: The Tousou Highway 2: Road Warrior 2050
Game.Overview: A racing game developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher. The story is set in the year 2050 A.D. on a highway in a world destroyed by a nuclear war.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 113: The Tairyou Jigoku
Game.Overview: The Tairyou Jigoku is an Action Adventure game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 114: The Onna Okappichi Torimonochou: Oharu-chan GoGoGo!
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 114: The Onna Okappichi Torimonochou - Oharu-chan GoGoGo! (ï¼³ï¼©ï¼­ï¼°ï¼¬ï¼¥ï¼’ï¼ï¼ï¼ã‚·ãƒªãƒ¼ã‚ºã€€ï¼¶ï½ï½Œï¼Žï¼‘ï¼‘ï¼”ã€€ï¼´ï¼¨ï¼¥ã€€å¥³å²¡ã£ãƒ”ãƒæ•ç‰©å¸³ ï½žãŠæ˜¥ã¡ã‚ƒã‚“ï¼§ï¼¯ï¼§ï¼¯ï¼§ï¼¯ï¼ï½ž) is a Beat 'em up video game published by D3Publisher released on February 22nd, 2007 for the PlayStation 2.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 115: The Roomshare toyuu Seikatsu.
Game.Overview: A room sharing simulator! Aiming to pass the university entrance exam, you spend one year sharing a room. Freely lay out more than 200 types of furniture and create a variety of environments to simulate a warm and relaxing communal life. If certain conditions are met, gravure idols and charismatic hosts will appear and you can live with them.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 116: The Neko-Mura no Ninnin Pagu Daikan no Akugyou Sanmai
Game.Overview: An action simulation game in which cats in a fairy world unfold in order to solve the unreasonable task of the pug magistrate. The main character, the cat princess he served, has gone missing. In order to find Nekohime, she enlists the help of the Pug magistrate, but... Let's capture the gimmicks scattered in 5 areas such as Nodokanohara, Twilight Mountain, Ototo Castle, Ushi no Tokimura, and Tokezu no Sato. You can also synthesize items with the materials you bring back. You can bring up to 30 companions with you. Let's find the cat princess by making full use of 7 occupations + Î± such as swordsman, courier, acrobat, and firefighter.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 117: The Reisen
Game.Overview: The Zerosen is a flight simulation game, developed by Mobile & Gamestudio and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 118: The Ochimusha: Doemu Samurai Toujou
Game.Overview: The Ochimusha - Doemu Samurai Toujou is an action game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 119: The Survival Game 2
Game.Overview: The Survival Game 2 is a first-person shooter game, developed by Best Media and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 120: The Saigo no Nihonhei: Utsukushiki Kokudo Dakkan Sakusen
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 120: Saigo no Nippon Hei: Utsukushiki Kokudo Dakkan Sakusen is an action game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 123: The Office Love Jikenbo: Reijou Tantei
Game.Overview: When a female co-worker commits suicide, it's up to you to find out what really happened. Talk to fellow co-workers to put the pieces of the puzzle together.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 12: The Quiz 20,000-mon
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.012 - The Quiz 20000 Mon is a quiz game with these game modes: - Quiz Mode: Choose a character and depending of the character the quiz genders will be different. This mode is for 1 player only. - Challenge Mode: Up to 4 players can play at the same time. Same as the Quiz Mode, depending of the character the questions will be different. - Quiz Version DX Mode: A board game in which if the player answer the questions in a right way he will win each square of the board. In this mode up to 4 players can play at the same time.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 13: Onna no Ko no Tame no: The Ren'ai Adventure: Garasu no Mori
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.013 - The Renai Adventure 2 - Garasu No Mori: Glass no Mori, full title The Renai Adventure ~Garasu no Mori~ (The Love Adventure ~Forest of Glass~) is a PS2 otome game developed by HuneX and published by D3. The game is volume 13 of the Simple Series line of budget games. The game tells the story of the protagonist's last visit to her deceased grandfather's house on the edge of a haunted forest in the countryside. The forest is rumoured to be a 'kamikakushi' that steals away children.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 15: The Rugby
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.015 - The Rugby is a simulation game that puts the player in the role of a high school rugby coach, he (with the help of his staff team members) can decide the teams members and each week trainings to make the best possible team and win the matches and tournaments.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 17: The Suiri: Arata naru 20 no Jikenbo
Game.Overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.017 - The Suiri Aratanaru 20 no Jikenbo is the Sequel to Simple 1500 Series Vol. 59: The Suiri, this detective graphical adventure is part of D3's budget Simple 2000 line.
The gameplay is exactly the same as the first game: Player becomes a detective that have to unravel the mystery of incidents and each story adventure game. The game is divided into 20 episodes. Play time is 5 to 15 minutes for each story. The gameplay is collects the tips by clicking on the screen and after that answer the questions. The bigger differences between this game and the previous one are the best resolution graphics and the character voice acting.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 19: The Renai Simulation: Renai Kissa Watashi ni Oma Cafe
Game.Overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 19: The Renai Simulation - Renai Kissa Watashi ni Oma Cafe is an Adventure game, developed by Vingt-et-un Systems and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2002.
The game begins when the parents of the main character shuffle died in a car accident, so now he is left in charge of the family coffee shop. The game now got some different part since the player has to manage the eatery and the waitresses, all of whom are lovely and potential love interests. During each week he has to decide about the coffee shop menus, the prices, what will be the waitress duties during that week and also what he is going to do that week (he can study management, rest, etc.). There are some times during each week that the player is giving some choices (like in all visual novel adventures) and depending of them the game ending will be different. If he got success he can buy new coffee shops, new waitress dresses, etc.
Depending of the player choices during the game the money that he earns and the interest of the girls in him will be different and so the game endings.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 1: The Table Game
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.001 - The Table Board that features different games: Mahjong, Igo, Go, Reversi, Hanafuda, card games, etc. The game also features another mode in which the player controls the boy that have to rescue the girl from a fantasy kindgom playing all the different games through the game (mahjongs, igo, go, reversi, hanafudas, etc) in the different places of that kingdom.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 21: The Bishoujo Simulation RPG: Moonlight Tale
Game.Overview: A RPG in which you work together with other girls to push through automatically generated dungeons. The girls have different special moves and stats depending on the clothes they wear!

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 22: The Tsuukin Densha Untenshi: Densha de Go! 3: Tsuukin-hen
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 27: The Pro Yakyuu: 2003 Pennant Race
Game.Overview: The Pro Yakyuu: 2003 Pennant Race is a baseball game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2003.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 29: The Ren'ai Board Game: Seishun 18 Radio
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.029 - The Renai Board Game Seishun 18 Radio: Youth 18 Radio is a board game that also incorporates slight adventure aspects and high-production anime movies with the completion of each scenario.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 34: The Ren'ai Horror Adventure: Hyouryuu Shoujo
Game.Overview:
It's a summer night and school shouldn't be where you're at but there you are with five lovely classmates. It's a group study session but an strange occurrence plunges the school underground and traps you and cohorts inside the storied halls of learning. Use the resources of your classmates and your own knowledge to find a way out of the school and return to your plain-Jane life.
All this would be fine and simple were it not for the strange creatures now roaming the halls. Even though monsters are afoot, love may blossom between you and one of your classmates during the time of strife and love horror.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 36: The Musume Ikusei Simulation: Otousan to Issho
Game.Overview: A daughter raising simulation game

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 38: Otoko no Tame no Bible: The Yuujou Adventure: Hotaru Soul
Game.Overview: Taiyou Suna is famous as an actor as well as a singer. However, his previous scandals are still known to everyone. The characters take advantage of this to increase the ratings on your TV show. However, after the truth is revealed, the TV men go out of their way to help him.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 40: The Touyou Sandai Senjutsu: Fuusui, Seimei Handan, Ekisen
Game.Overview: A fortune telling game.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 43: The Saiban: Shinmai Shihoukan Momota Tsukasa no 10 no Saiban File
Game.Overview:
Simple 2000 Series vol.43 - The Saiban: Shinmaishihoukan Momodashi no 10 no Saiban File is the 43rd installment in D3's ongoing Simple 2000 budget series of games. You slip into the role of a junior lawyer and try to solve 10 different scenarios, which all work together to set up a twisting detective story and court drama. Gameplay involves understanding and convincing the jurors, using diplomacy and all the tools of the trade to win the case.
20XX year, by the revision of the judicial system, the jury system have been introduced in Japan's trial. The main here, Momota Tsukasa got a part-time job for a law firm. With the help of a legal research software and a secretary she will have to try to solve the different cases gaining the jury favours.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 44: The Hajimete no RPG: Densetsu no Keishousha
Game.Overview: The region of Lordenias has seen a peaceful era for the last 400 years thanks to a single hero. However, this time was coming to an end. The king of Magura who controls the south-east island "Sylvania" was fascinated by demons and planned to revive the god of evil. Demons began to appear all over the island and soon the people began to disappear. The demonic forces turn their gaze towards Mid Earth. You will play as the protagonist and go on an adventure to save the world that has fallen. Travel around the world listening to people and gathering information. Around 100 kinds of monster, 50 kinds of magic, and 40 kinds of weapons and protective gear are available in this game.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 46: The Kanji Quiz: Challenge! Kanji Kentei
Game.Overview: A game for all people who love to learn Kanji. This game can be easily suggested for anyone wanting to improve their Kanji skills and features modes that let you do it the fun way instead of turning to your boring textbook. There is even a vs. mode to test your Kanji knowledge against a friend!

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 47: The Kassen Sekigahara
Game.Overview: Lead the Western Army to victory in this decisive war! In order to defeat the commander-in-chief, Tokugawa Ieyasu, you must slash through a horde of enemy soldiers that fill the screen in this thrilling swordplay action game. There are seven stages in total. Use the "Lock-on System" to lock onto a horde of enemies and unleash your special move, the "Lightning Consecutive Attack," to slash them down one after the other!

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 4: The Double Mahjong Puzzle
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.004 - The Double Mahjong Puzzle is a puzzle game with 2 different kind of puzzles based on mahjong. In both games there is a time limit and when is reaches zero is game over. - Gekitoride: Here the goal is to put together mahjong pieces of the same kind and make them dissapear. In this mode there are 2 different modes (Arcade & Infinity). - Space: This time the game is in 3d, the goal is to clear the cube joining 3 mahjong pieces taken from the cube (Arcade & Border).

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 56: The Survival Game
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 57: The Pro Yakyuu 2004
Game.Overview: A baseball game for PlayStation 2, released as part of the Simple 2000 series in Japan.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 58: The Gekai
Game.Overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 58: The Gekai is a medical adventure game for PlayStation 2 that follows the life of a young surgeon working in the General Surgery Department of Seito University Hospital. The story begins when the protagonist is suddenly assigned to operate on a patient suffering from acute appendicitis, who turns out to be the case of a close colleague. As professional conflicts, ambition, and betrayal begin to surface within the surgical department, the protagonist must confront the question of what it truly means to be a doctor.
Gameplay combines visual novel storytelling with interactive surgical simulations. Players take direct control during thirteen different operations, including appendectomies and esophageal cancer resections, each based on real medical procedures. Every surgery must be completed under pressure, with limited time and the patientâ€™s condition constantly at risk.
Successful operations improve the surgeonâ€™s skill level and unlock special abilities. The story branches based on the playerâ€™s decisions and surgical performance, leading to eight unique scenarios and six possible endings. Through these choices, the game challenges players to balance ambition, morality, and compassion in the high-stakes world of modern surgery.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 59: The Uchuujin to Hanasou! Uchuujin tte Naani
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 60: The Tokusatsu Henshin Hero
Game.Overview:
Choose a hero, male or female and battle against an evil organization, your enemies are some sort of ugly aliens!
Lobster-man, yellow monster-man, a strange egyptian woman and a poweful ancient samurai are only a few of the strange foes you have to overcome. More you fight, more you became powerful: between each stage the Professor gives you the possibility to improve your fighting tecniques, choose what suits you best!

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 62: The Super Puzzle Bobble DX
Game.Overview:
Super Puzzle Bobble, released as Super Bust-A-Move in Europe and North America, is a puzzle video game in the Puzzle Bobble series. It was developed by Taito, and released on November 26, 2000 by Acclaim Entertainment for the PlayStation 2 and Windows. It was later ported to the Game Boy Advance on November 27, 2001. It was re-released in Japan for the PlayStation 2 in 2004 as part of Super Puzzle Bobble DX (along with its sequel, Super Puzzle Bobble 2), which is Volume 62 of the Japan-exclusive Simple 2000 Series. This compilation includes a few graphical enhancements.
Super Puzzle Bobble was ported to the GameCube in 2003, under the name of Super Puzzle Bobble All-Stars in Japan, Super Bust-A-Move All-Stars in Europe and Bust-A-Move 3000 in North America. The game is a direct port, except for the inclusion of new backgrounds and remixed music. It also features new box artwork, more in line with the in-game artwork.
It is the first mainstream game in the series not to see an arcade release, although there is an arcade game with the same title, which is a completely different game to this one.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 66: The Party Unou Quiz
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.066 - The Party Unou Quiz is a brain building game which exercises minds with visual puzzles designed to delight and tease right-brain functions. According to experiments by Nobel Prize winner Roger Sperry, the right brain handles visual clues, symbols, and grasps the big picture.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 67: The Suiri: Soshite Dare mo Inaku Natta
Game.Overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.067 - The Suiri - Soshite Daremo Inakunatta is the Sequel to Simple 2000 Series Vol. 17: The Suiri Aratanaru 20 no Jikenbo, this detective graphical adventure is part of D3's budget Simple 2000 line.
The gameplay is exactly the same as the first game: Player becomes a detective that have to unravel the mystery of incidents and each story adventure game. The game is divided into 20 episodes. Play time is 5 to 15 minutes for each story. The gameplay is collects the tips by clicking on the screen and after that answer the questions. The bigger differences between this game and the previous one are the best resolution graphics and the character voice acting.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 69: The Board Game Collection
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Vol.069 - The Board Game Collection: Originally released as European Game Collection, this game is a collection of 5 different board games: Midnight Party, Geister, Zirkus Flohcati, Cartagena & Ursuppe.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 70: The Kanshikikan
Game.Overview: The Kanshikikan is an adventure title where players take on the role of a forensic investigator. The first installment of what would later become a sub-series of its own.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 73: The Saiyuu Touenden
Game.Overview: The Saiyuki Saruden: Based on the legendary Monkey series, this game requires you to protect the priestess Tripitaka from maurading demons with help of course from Pigsy, Sandy and Dragon. Genki awaits the appearance of the fractions demons from the seminal series with bated breath.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 75: The Tokudane: Nihon Zenkoku Scoop Rettou
Game.Overview: The Tokudane is a board game, developed by Tomcat System and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2005.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 76: The Hanasou Eigo no Tabi
Game.Overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 76 - The Hanasou Eigo no Tabi is an educational quiz game in which the player is a japanese tourist (there is the choice to be a boy or a girl at the beginning of the game) that travels to the United States for the first time. In the game the player is supposed to stay for a week in a certain town, in which he will have to communicate in English with the town people and that will deep the friendship while puzzled about cross-cultural questions and memories.
All conversation are in English of course. The game features recorded conversation from various patterns that are from simple English to a bit more complicated English. It is possible to try many times to answer even if you fail. In addition, the correct translation can be viewed, to learn English at their player's own pace.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 77: The Hanasou Hangul no Tabi
Game.Overview: The Hanasou Kankokugo no Tabi is an educational quiz game in which the player travels to Korea.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 79: Akko ni Omakase! The Party Quiz
Game.Overview: This entry in D3's Simple series of budget titles is set up like a television quiz show, with over 1000 questions included. In addition to a couple of single player quiz modes, the game lets up to eight players get together for multiplayer play using the multitap. The game includes four unique types of quizzes.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 83: The Konchuu Saishuu
Game.Overview: Strap on the Birkenstocks, jostle into the hemp shorts, and wander into the wilderness in search of bugs. As the story goes, a whole mess of insects have escaped from a laboratory. Gone. The hapless scientist at the lab charges the player with the task of finding the same bugs that fit the lab's specimen needs. The setting of the game takes place during summer vacation and the player adopts the persona of a boy with a fascination for insects. A rascally blue-haired girl plays the part of a rival that is also collecting specimens for the lab and barging in on your action.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 84: The Boku ni Oma-Cafe: Kimagure Strawberry Cafe
Game.Overview: In Kimagure Strawberry Cafe you play as Ichigo Mizuhara (default name) and your luck left you when your parents suddenly decide to have a trip for a whole year. Things couldn't get any worse, now you are in charge of a cafe that your parents left you. Well things aren't so bad when you have a childhood friend and your cute underclassmen to help you run the cafe. And who say lady luck just left you, when now suddenly you are stranded to manage the cafe with 5 cute guys.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 85: The Sekai Meisaku Gekijou Quiz
Game.Overview: The 85th volume of D3's Simple 2000 series is a quiz game featuring questions from 22 years of anime, totaling over 23 productions. The game includes over 5000 questions from such properties as Peter Pan no Bouken, Romeo no Aoi Sora, Trap Ikka Monogatari, and Flanders no Inu. Gameplay modes include Memorial Quiz, where you select from 8 works and answer questions set in multiple stages that follow the production's storyline, Solo Quiz, where you select from 8 works and 6 genres and work to keep a life meter from reaching zero, and Travel Quiz in which two players answer questions pulled from eight productions simultaneously. The game includes summaries of the original works which provide hints to performing well in the question sessions.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 86: The Menkyo Shutoku Simulation: Kaisei Douro Koutsuuhou Taiou-ban
Game.Overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.086 - The Menkyou Shutoku Simulation is a simulation game about getting a driving license. the game features over 3000 different questions, the game features over his previous version (Simple 2000 Series Vol.25 - The Menkyo Shutoku Simulation) the traffic laws updates of the year 2005. The game features ordinary car license, ordinary motorcycle license, limited ordinary motorcycle license & moped license.
The game is divided into 2 different parts, the test parts in which the player have to answer different questions and go to past the different exams, and the driving part in which the player drives the car in the practices (and after getting the licenses in the town) in a top down perspective.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 88: The Mini-suke Police
Game.Overview: You play as Momo Samejima, a special forces agent. Your mission is to assassinate the leader of an organization that's secretly selling a potent new drug, Perorin. You'll make use of guns and grenades as you sneak into a city and face off against enemies in 3D. The chief draw of the game, even though it promises action-packed excitement, is what the special forces agent is wearing -- a mini-skirt! She tackles thugs with swift kicks in her short, short skirt. She blasts away at goons in her stocking-accessorized, ultra-short China-look dress. She may even have to sashay down guarded hallways in nothing but a bikini, with no mini-skirt on at all!

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 90: The OneeChambara 2
Game.Overview:
The Oneechanbara 2 is a full sequel to the first Oneechanbara game and is the third one in the series.
Of the four PlayStation 2 games of the Oneechanbara "Simple 2000" franchise made, this is the only one that did not receive a European release.
After having finally defeated her younger sister Saki but refraining from mortally wounding her, Aya takes her to the hospital only to discover her missing after Saki had suffered a strange "fever". In trying to find her, Aya encounters the mysterious motorcycle helmet-wearing Reiko trying to murder Saki; after stopping her, Aya uncovers a sinister plot.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 92: The Noroi no Game
Game.Overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 92: The Noroi no Game is a game that merges live-action horror movies with horror sound novels, this game promises to deliver a frightening experience. You'll have to solve puzzles to avoid the fears that haunt you and work your way to a good ending.
The plot is about that different people are receiving the game and one after another died after playing it, so the player has to solve the curse and try to reach the good ending.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 93: The Unou Drill: Kodama Mitsuo Sensei Kanshuu
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.093 - The Unou Drill: Also released in PSP. Brain training hits the PS2. Based off Kodama Mitsuo's Right Brain Drill program, the game includes ten drill types as well as an IQ test. The game features 3 different difficulty levels: beginner, intermediate & advanced.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 94: The Aka-Champion: Come On Baby
Game.Overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 94: The Aka-Champion: Come On Baby is a 2005 release for PS2 from D3 Publisher and developer Expotato. It's the home version of their 2000 arcade game.
Come on Baby is a sports game with a difference, all the competitors are babies. Players select their character and compete in many different events. Events include dancing, driving, sumo wrestling, running races, water races and more.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 97: The Koi no Engine: Darling Special Backlash: Koi no Exhaust Heat
Game.Overview:
A racing themed love/relationship simulation game, Darling Special Backlash: Ai no Exhaust Heat (the steamy subtitle translates to Exhaust Heat of Love) follows the exploits of a team of young male drivers, who compete for the racing group Team Angstrom.
Since the (unseen) main character is a girl with the customizable name of Hitomi, gameplay consists of conversations with said male drivers like Kei Kakami, Arthur Kouka Nagazawa, and Hayato Takashima. Conversations lead to specific events and story twists, which in turn, lead to different types of endings. Will you find happiness?
The original release was available in two different versions, a standard one and a box set with an additional music CD.

Game.Name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 9: The Ren'ai Adventure: Bittersweet Fools
Game.Overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.009 - The Renai Adventure - Bittersweet Fools is a visual novel eroge developed by Minori. It was ported to the Dreamcast and PlayStation 2 with H-content removed as part of the Simple series line of "renai adventure" games. It is vol.1 on the Dreamcast and vol.9 on the PS2. The anime opening of the game was directed by Makoto Shinkai. The game takes place in Florence, Italy. The character design is by Yu Aida, whose Gunslinger Girl series also takes place in Italy.

Game.Name: Simple Outlaws DX Gaiden: Chou Saisoku! Zokusha King Bore Up: Butchigiri Densetsu 2
Game.Overview: Simple Outlaws DX Gaiden: Chou Saisoku! Zokusha King Bore Up: Butchigiri Densetsu 2 is a racing game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Game.Name: Sinbad Adventure wa Enomoto Kanako de Dou desu ka
Game.Overview: Sinbad Adventure wa Enomoto Kanako de Dou Desu ka is a pachinko game, published by Nippon Amuse, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Game.Name: SingStar
Game.Overview:
SingStar is a competitive music video game series for PlayStation consoles, developed by London Studio and published by Sony Computer Entertainment. Dozens of installments were released for the PlayStation 2, and several more for the PlayStation 3. The games have also undergone a number of non-English releases in various European countries.
SingStar games are distributed either as the software alone, or bundled with a pair of USB microphones â€“ one red, one blue; wireless microphones are also available. The games are compatible with the EyeToy and PlayStation Eye cameras, allowing players to see themselves singing.

Game.Name: SingStar '80s
Game.Overview: Everyone who's played SingStar with a bunch of friends knows it's the most fun you can have in your living room. Now, relive some of the finest musical moments of your youth in SingStar '80s. Bring the decade back to life with your own glorious renditions of top tunes from the likes of Simple Minds, The Cure, Vanilla Ice and Europe. Fill your lungs with air and deliver the finest power ballad your neighbours will ever hear. Shed tears of joy as you hear the songs that shaped your very being delivered by over-enthusiastic acquaintances. Experience the '80s as they were always meant to sound with SingStar '80s

Game.Name: SingStar '90s
Game.Overview: Yeah, it's SingStar time again..this time with songs from The Divinyls, EMF, Lisa Loeb, Sir Mix-A-Lot, the Cardigans, and a few more.

Game.Name: SingStar ABBA
Game.Overview:
SingStar ABBA is a karaoke game featuring songs from the Swedish group ABBA. The group was active during the seventies, particularly in the disco/pop music.
The game gives points which are distributed by the purity of singing, as in how well does one manage to stay on tune. It doesn't matter if you change octaves in the middle of the song or what words are you singing in (it doesn't have a word recognition), so your singing is rated by how well you manage to hit the correct note at the correct time.

Game.Name: SingStar Afrikaanse Treffers

Game.Name: Singstar: R&B
Game.Overview:
SingStar is a competitive music video game series, developed by London Studio and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 2 and PlayStation 3 video game consoles. SingStar allows 1-2 people to sing karaoke via microphone peripherals in time with on-screen music. The first game in the series, SingStar, was released in Europe and Oceania in 2004. As of 2008, over seventy titles in the SingStar series have been released PAL region territories, in addition to a small number of releases in North America.
The main difference between each SingStar title is the game's track list. Each edition of the game includes up to thirty songs on disc, with PlayStation 3 versions of the game allowing additional songs to be purchased from an online service. Players can remove a game disc from the console during gameplay and insert a new disc, giving them access to a new selection of songs. Most SingStar titles are loosely based upon musical genres, such as rock or pop music (SingStar Rocks! and SingStar Pop respectively). SingStar games are sometimes localised for release in different regions, with customised track lists to suit foreign markets and territories. The first artist-specific SingStar game (SingStar Die Toten Hosen) was released in Germany in 2007, with ABBA, Queen, Take That, Mecano and Vasco Rossi receiving similar releases in subsequent years.
Singstar Norske/Svenska Hits are localised variants of SingStar Pop.

Game.Name: SingStar: Rocks!
Game.Overview: SingStar games require players to sing along with music in order to score points. Players interface with their console via SingStar microphones while a music video plays in the background. The pitch players are required to sing is displayed as horizontal grey bars, which function similar to a musical stave, with corresponding lyrics displayed at the bottom of the screen. The game analyses a player's pitch and timing which is compared to the original track, with players scoring points based on how accurate their singing is. Different modes of SingStar may vary this basic pattern, but the principle is similar throughout.

Game.Name: SingStar: Russkij Hit
Game.Overview:
Having a karaoke party at your home is easy! The SingStar series of games dramatically transforms any holiday and helps to reveal your vocal talents. Sing songs from your favorite artists and compete with your friends to see who deserves to be called the master. Feel like a pop star with a real microphone in your hands. With EyeToy camera support, you can even see yourself on screen!
â€œSingStar Russian Hitâ€ opens your way to the world of Russian pop music. Now you can sing your favorite Russian-language songs of the most famous soloists and groups. The list of performers included â€œZhukiâ€, Maxim, Eurovision hero Dima Bilan, Lolita, Vlad Topalov, â€œDancing Minusâ€, â€œTea for Twoâ€ and even Alla Pugacheva with Kristina Orbakaite! Arrange an unforgettable musical evening with the participation of the best Russian singers and singers!
'Stars' of Russian pop music! â€œSingStar Russian Hitâ€ is entirely dedicated to domestic performers. Brothers Grim, Tutsi, Stas Piekha, Panayotov, Dima Bilan, Maxim, Lolita - this is not a complete list of celebrities whose songs you can perform. Sing into a real microphone. Includes two stylish microphones so you can perform with your friends! Less falsehood, higher score! The game will appreciate your skill. It takes into account the pitch, as well as the timing and duration of the note. The more accurately you sing, the more points you get. Against each other or together? You can compete with a friend in vocal skills or sing a duet with him! Original video clips. For each of your performances there will be a bright, stylish video clip with your favorite performer in the title role! Be transported to the screen. The game is configured to work with the EyeToy camera, which can transfer your image to the TV screen.

Game.Name: Siren
Game.Overview:
Resist the Call!
0:00. Midnight. A Siren calls and a sea of red water mysteriously surrounds the mountain village Hanuda. Slowly, a terrible force transforms the inhabitants into Shibito, undead husks of their old selves, fueled by evil and hate.
Play as one of ten characters caught in a living nightmare. You have three days to learn how their paths intersect as they try to stay alive. Survival depends on your ability to "Sightjack" or the power to see through the eyes of friends and foes. There is no lone hero, there is little hope.

Game.Overview: Welcome to the whimsical world of Sitting Ducks, where life is good, food?s a plenty, and alligators are lurking in neighbouring Swampwood. One bird stands out amongst the flock ? Bill. Well-liked, but seldom understood, Bill waddles to a different beat. He is a quirky, smaller than average duck with a big imagination and a secret fun loving side. Bill?s best friend is Aldo, from the neighbouring town of Swampwood. A big lumbering bull-in-a-china-shop alligator, chock-full of rough edges. Aldo is also a tough guy with a soft centre. This unlikely friendship between these two creatures on opposite ends of the food chain sets the scene for unique challenges ? and a lot of fun.

Game.Name: Skate Attack
Game.Overview: Skate Attack takes the best part of the famous Tony Hawke series the innovative style of Jet Set Radio Future, mixing them together with its special ingredients in order to create the most attractive, creative and fun skateboarding game ever seen on any platform. As you enter this futuristic city you will realize that "Virus" (a crazy casino mascot) has escaped from its billboard and kidnapped one of your skateboarding buddies. Join the other skaters and act together to free the missing boy. It will not be a simple task but you have all the moves and weapons you need. With over 30 individual moves such as lip, grind, kick and endless numbers of combinations, you can put together the necessary moves to win the challenge. If this is not enough you can use the Drones, flying robots that populate the city and take them around or drive them inside your enemies for total destruction. Costs what it costs, dominate your table and free the city for all skaters!

Game.Name: Skateboard Madness: Xtreme Edition
Game.Overview: Skateboard Madness Xtreme Edition is a skateboard game on Playstation 2. This app offers you to become the rising star of skateboarding by participating in the most prestigious competitions, trying to tease the pros, and trying the wildest tricks.

Game.Name: Ski and Shoot
Game.Overview: SKI AND SHOOT is an arcade, tactical 3D simulation of one of the most popular winter sports. Compete against other skiers on tracks that wind through wonderful wintery landscapes under the shadow of snow-capped mountains. Tuck to increase your speed...

Game.Name: Ski-Doo: Snow X Racing
Game.Overview:
SXR is a snowmobile racing game in the lineage of Splashdown.
The player will race in four countries (USA, Canada, Sweden, and Russia) and 18 tracks. Different game modes include a career, quick, simple race mode and splitscreen multiplayer. During race, player-controlled snowmobile can perform up to 16 different tricks. Customization of the vehicle is also possible.

Game.Name: Ski Jumping Pairs Reloaded
Game.Overview: Players take part in a fictional tandem ski jumping competition. Choose from a number of nations - each with their own unique way of jumping!

Game.Name: Skip Beat!
Game.Overview: This work is a novel-type adventure game that progresses by reading the message, and the story changes in various ways by choosing the options that appear from time to time, and eventually the ending follows the flow of the story so far. The player becomes the main character "Kyoko Mogami" who belongs to the LME entertainment production "Love Me Club" and can experience the world of "Skip Beat!". It's up to the player to choose between love, work and friendship.

Game.Name: Ski Racing 2005
Game.Overview: Ski Racing 2005 is an officially licensed downhill racing game on skis. It includes ski pistes from various real locations such as KitzbÃ¼hl, Garmisch-Partenkirchen and Val d'IsÃ¨re. The game comes with four game modes taken directly from the world championships. They are slalom, giant slalom, super-g and downhill. The game modes each focus on speed and manoeuvrability.

Game.Name: Ski Racing 2006
Game.Overview: Ski Racing 2006 is an officially licensed downhill racing game on skis. It is the sequel to Ski Racing 2005 - featuring Hermann Maier. It includes ski pistes from various real locations such as KitzbÃ¼hl, Garmisch-Partenkirchen and Val d'IsÃ¨re. It comes with all the locations from its predecessor. You can play the game in three different difficulties and it comes with the same game modes as the previous game taken directly from the world championships. They are slalom, giant slalom, super-g and downhill; new is the World Cup mode. The game modes each focus on speed and manoeuvrability. You can play against fifteen stars including Bode Miller, Daron Rahlves, Kalle Pallander, Didier Defago and Hermann Maier to battle for the Crystal Goblet.

Game.Name: SkyGunner
Game.Overview:
SkyGunner is a third person flight combat game, with its emphasis on action. Players choose to take the role of either Ciel, Femme, or Copain, each with their own campaign and unique flying abilities and special skill. Players can turn the plane's direction up, down, left and right, perform barrel rolls, and use afterburners. Weaponry is handled by a complex system of targeting, with involves two types: "Look Targeting" and "Weapon Lock". Look Targeting simply assigns a particular enemy at the center of the camera and can be switched between at any time. The player must still maneuver near the enemy and target them with the cross hairs in order to shoot them. Depending on the secondary weapon selected, players can roll the cross hairs over the wing leader of an enemy group or the sequentially lead gun on a battleship, allowing the player to instantly target multiples from that group.
The primary weapon of each airplane is a machine gun which fires straight ahead. More destructive secondary weapons are also available, that includes Firework Missiles which create area explosions, Dog Missiles which slow and/or immobilize targets and Cross Missiles which stick to targets and need to be shot by a machine gun to detonate. Copain also has his own weapon, the Pumpkin Bomb which is a big destructive bomb. These secondary weapons are automatically replenished with the destruction of chains of enemies and/or combos. Chains/Combos are also the way to activate score multipliers, which affect the amount of money won in each mission. Ciel, Copain and Femme are continually in competition throughout the game and often bonuses (such as faster engines) are given to the character with the highest score in specific missions. Bonus scores are also awarded for specific mission events.

Game.Name: Sky Odyssey
Game.Overview:
Arcade-style mission-based combat-free flight simulator.
Features 10 different aircraft (7 of which must be unlocked), ranging from the Swordfish Mk. 1 biplane to jets to UFO's. All craft can be customized with parts earned by completing missions.
Includes 5 different game modes: Adventure Mode, in which you fly a series of missions searching for the map pieces needed to find the legendery Tower of Maximus; Target Mode, in which you must navigate through a series of targets; Sky Canvas Mode, in which you paint patterns in the sky; Training Mode, a basic tutorial; and Free Flight Mode, in which you can fly freely around any of the maps you've seen in the adventure mode.
Missions in the adventure mode include such daring stunts as landing on moving trains, landing on an aircraft carrier in the middle of a storm, mid-air refuelling, and flying through caves, canyons, and forests. Weather effects are well-modelled, and you'll be buffetted around by strong winds and pushed down by strong rain and snow.

Game.Name: Skyscraper
Game.Overview:
Just when he thought his day couldnâ€™t get any worseâ€¦
Christopher Wilson, a scientist working at Tigra Corpa Chemical Research, finds himself trapped in his office after a mercenary assault on the building. With all his colleagues held hostage, Chris must take matters into his own handsâ€¦
â€¢ Use your scientific brain to hack into computers, bypass security systems and recode your pass to progress
â€¢ Make explosive cocktails by finding and mixing chemicals for different results. Remember: explosions can hurt you too!
â€¢ Use the cover system to stay alive â€“ scientists donâ€™t have the advantage of body armour
â€¢ Use a wide variety of weapons - a new experience for Chris

Game.Name: Sky Surfer
Game.Overview:
Jump out of a plane, maneuver to control points, use upwinds, be sure to open your parachute early enough. While falling, do tricks for points. Offers also training modes above a huge fan, trying to collect as many balloons as possible.
Several Sky Boards and Jumpers to chose from. Analogue stick only! Only released in Japan and Europe. The European release has more scenarios!

Game.Name: S.L.A.I.: Steel Lancer Arena International
Game.Overview:
S.L.A.I. â€“ Steel Lancer Arena International is a Playstation 2 sequel to 2002 XBox title Phantom Crash. The story takes place 40 years after the events in Phantom Crash and cyber-punk athletes continue to battle their robots in arenas created by destroyed uninhabitable environments.
S.L.A.I. (pronounced â€œslayâ€) is an arena based robot fighting game. Controls are similar to most console FPSâ€™s, but the camera can be switched between first person cockpit view and behind the robot third person view. Defeated opponents are replaced with new entrants until the player is defeated, leaves the arena, or time runs out. Money is based on performance and can be used to buy new robot parts and adjust existing parts for speed and power. Finally, the onboard â€œanimal chipâ€ gains experience depending on performance and increases the robots lock-on speed, armor, reticule size, and more.

Game.Name: Slam Tennis
Game.Overview:
Two different extremes of tennis are combined here. The four Grand Slam venues are among the 11 featured, but so are a mansion and a dance hall. These surfaces all affect ball speed and bounce. A few real players such as Carlos Moya and Tim Henman are included, but most are created for the game - a lifeguard and a mayor are included, with abilities based on their real-life work.
As well as playing individual Exhibition matches, you can take on an Arcade challenge of defeating the 16 players or take on the full Slam Tennis Championship event. Forehand, backhand and lob shots are all available. There are also sub-games: Crazy Collapsing Columns, Bubble Bursting Bonanza, Rocking Ring Riot, and Sand, Sea and Serve,

Game.Name: Sled Storm
Game.Overview:
Sled Storm is a snowmobile racing video game for the PlayStation 2. It features 7 tracks with many shortcuts. The 8 characters vary in trick abilities, and they each have distinct snowmobiles. The soundtrack features Hein Hoven, John Morgan, Morphadron, Overseer and Sulpher.
In comparison to Sled Storm some of the main notable differences include:
Different game modes The PSX has a split-screen mode for up to 4 players, while the PS2 only has a two-players split-screen mode. Additionally, the PS2 game has a Rival Challenge mode.
Different starter characters The PSX features Jay, Ryan, Tracey, Gio, Travis and Nadia, while PS2 features Tracey Maretti, TJ Rallins, Zoe Payne, Sam Griffin, Niklas Ericksson, Gavin Meyer, Psymon Stark and Alix Kinoshita.
Different tracks PSX tracks are called Pine Valley, Kodiak Canyon, Hard pack, Eagle Ridge, glacial Grind, Goatâ€™s Bluff, while PS2 tracks are Cedar Canyon (Canada), Bermuda Berg, Rumble Ridge (Argentina), Twinn Peaks (France), Black Diamond (Sweden), Beast from the east (China), Polarfest (Alaska).
Different soundtrack PSX soundtrack features Rob Zombie, Econoline Crush, EZ rollers, Jeff Dyck, while the PS2 soundtrack features Hein Hoven, John Morgan, Morphadron, Overseer and Sulpher.

Game.Name: Slot! Pro DX: Fujiko 2
Game.Overview: Slot! Pro DX: Fujiko 2 is a Pachinko game, published by Nippon Telenet, which was released in Japan in 2003

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core 10: Mach GoGoGo2
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Core 10: Mach GoGoGo2 is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core 11: Kyojin no Hoshi IV: Seishun Gunzou-hen
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Core 11: Kyojin no Hoshi IV: Seishun Gunzou-hen is a gambling game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core 12: PinPon
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Core 12: PinPon is a gambling game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core 2: Gouda! Minami no Teiou
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Core 2 - Gouda Minami no Teiou is a Japanese skill-stop slot machine. It is similar to traditional (auto-stop) slot machines, except with Pachislo, the player uses three buttons to stop the reels, which requires some skill. The machine accepts tokens and features an LCD screen, music and extra reels, which enhances the standard reel play. The spin knob on a Pachislo machine is located on the front of the cabinet instead of a handle on the side on a traditional slot machine.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core 3
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Core 3 is a Slot machine game, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core 4: Ton-chan Gekida! Jissen Pachi-Slot Ore-izm!!
Game.Overview: Slotter UP Core 4: Don-chan Gekiuchi! Jissen Pachi-Slot Ore Izuma is a gambling game, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core 5: Lupin Daisuki! Shuyaku wa Zenigata
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Core 5 is a Pachinko game, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2004

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core 6: Bakuenda! Kyojin no Hoshi II
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Core 6: Bakuenda! Kyojin no Hoshi II is a gambling game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2005.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core 7: Dekitou da! Street Fighter II
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Core 7: Dekitou da! Street Fighter II is a Slot machine game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2005

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core 8 : Kyojin no Hoshi III
Game.Overview: Slot machine simulator based on the emotional, epic anime full of hard love known as Kyojin no Hoshi (or Star of the Giants.) The story of the anime features young Hoshi as he battles through gruelling training and beatings from his strict father to become a pitcher for the Tokyo Giants. Its unlikely father would have approved of the fruit machine gambling exploits, but a top baseball player must squander their cash on something.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core 9: Jug Kiwametari! Final Juggler
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Core 9: Jug Kyoku Tare! Final Juggler is a gambling game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core Alpha: Shuku Tora! Yuushou Panel! Shinka! Kyojin no Hoshi
Game.Overview: Slotter UP Core Alpha is a gambling game, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2003.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Core: Honou-da! Kyojin no Hoshi
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Core: Honou-da! Kyojin no Hoshi is casino style slot machine simulator, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2003.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Mania 10: Pioneer Special III
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Mania 10: Pioneer Special III is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Mania 11: 2027 vs 2027 II
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Mania 11: 2027 vs 2027 II is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Mania 2: Kokuchi no Kyoku! Juggler Special
Game.Overview: Slotter UP Mania 2 is a gambling game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2003.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Mania 3: Densetsu Fukkatsu! New Pegasus Special
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Mania 3 - New Pegasus Special is a pachinko simulation, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2003. The game features a perfect simulation of the 3 pachinko machine Pegasus series (New Olympia Pegasus, New Pegasus A & New Pegasus L) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Mania 4: Nangoku no Kou! Super Hana Hana & Shiomahal & Oase
Game.Overview: Slotter UP Mania 4 is a gambling game, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Mania 5
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Mania 5 - Soukaigekida Mach Go Go Go & Daruma Neko is a pachinko simulation, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2004. The game features a perfect simulation of 2 pachinko Pioneer machines (Mach Go Go Go & Manekineko Plus Daruma) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Mania 6
Game.Overview:
Slotter Up Mania 6 - Oki no Neppuu Pioneer Special 2 is a pachinko simulation, the game features a perfect simulation of 2 pachinko Pioneer machines (Super Sio Sai & Big Siosienne) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.
Japanese slot machines, known as pachisuro or pachislo (portmanteaus of the words "pachinko" and "slot machine"), are a descendant of the traditional Japanese pachinko game. Slot machines are a fairly new phenomenon and they can be found in mostly in pachinko parlors and the adult sections of amusement arcades, known as game centers.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Mania 7
Game.Overview:
Slotter Up Mania 7 - Saishinsaikyou Pioneer Max is a pachinko simulation, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2005. The game features a perfect simulation of 2 pachinko Pioneer machines (Super Sio Sai & Big Siosienne) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.
Slotter Up Mania 7 features two machines from pachislot maker Pioneer. The game lets you switch on auto play so that you can collect data over a lengthy period. This is for people who feel that by playing these games they can improve their pachinko skills and translate that into real money at the pachinko parlor.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Mania 8
Game.Overview:
Slotter Up Mania 8 - Juggler Special 2 is a pachinko simulation, the game features a perfect simulation of 4 pachinko Pioneer machines (Go Go Juggler V, Go Go Juggler S-30, Juggler Girl & Juggler TM) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.
Slotter Up Mania 8 includes four machines from the well-known Juggler line of pachislot machines. The game includes a practice mode which lets you work on your strategy. Visuals and sound are meant to replicate the actual machine.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Mania 9
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Mania 9 - Atsu Oki Daze! Mensore30 & Mensore 2-30 is a pachinko simulation game developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2007. The game features a perfect simulation of 2 pachinko machines (Mensore30 & Mensore 2-30) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.

Game.Name: Slotter Up Mania: Chou Oki-Slot! Pioneer Special
Game.Overview: Slotter Up Mania - Chou Oki Slot Pioneer Special is a pachinko simulation game. The game features a perfect simulation of 8 pachinko machines ("Sound of the surf -30" "Kimberly -30" "King Castle -30" "Hana Hana -30" "Shiora -30", etc.) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.

Game.Name: Sly 2: Band of Thieves
Game.Overview:
Thief and raccoon Sly Cooper returns in a new cel-shaded platforming adventure wherein he forms a band of thieves with Bentley the turtle and Murray the purple, hippo-like creature, which each have their own role within the game.
Sly is the fastest, most agile member of the band of thieves and still is the character you play with the most. But certain missions require the special abilities of Bentley, who is smart and can drop bombs, as well shoot enemies from a distance. Other missions require the muscles of Murray, who can lift nearly everything, including enemies.
The main goal of the game is the retrieval of a number of clockwork pieces from different locations around the world. Each theft has to be prepared with a number of sub-missions which have to be completed before the 'real thing' can begin.
Game.Genres: Action; Adventure; Beat 'em Up; Platform; Stealth

Game.Name: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves
Game.Overview: Sly and the gang is back in this third outing of Sly Raccoon-series. This time, the story takes the boys (Sly, Bentley and Murray) to the fortress that houses the treasures of Sly's family. Although they are still weary from the adventures in the previous game, they have to get up and face the new threat that could mean the end of Sly's business and the loss of his family heritage. The game itself is a lot like the previous games: Sly sneaks, jumps, and swings himself around the levels, collecting various items, defeating bad guys and ultimately taking on the boss character. The other members of the gang step in on the action once in a while but the Sly centric sections are the main focus of the game. If you like games that had many things to do, this sneak-em-up/platform/action/adventure/puzzle game is for you.
Game.Genres: Action; Adventure; Beat 'em Up; Platform; Stealth

Game.Name: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus
Game.Overview:
Sly Cooper is the latest in a long line of master thieves. When he was a kit, a gang called the Fiendish Five killed his family and divided up their book on the art of thieving: the Thievius Raccoonus. Sly must defeat all the members of the gang to recover the book while evading Carmelita Fox, a police officer chasing him around the world to apprehend him.
This game is divided into five worlds, each themed around a particular part of the world and the villain headquartered there. Most worlds are structured as a central hub with entrances to numerous individual levels. Each of the levels has a primary goals which earns you a key. You must collect all the keys in the world to fight the world's boss.
Many of the levels have a platformer structure. The objective of these worlds is to reach the location of the key. There are substantial stealth elements here as you must dodge searchlights and trips lasers which set off alarms and avoid alerting guards. In addition to the main objective, there are clue bottles to find. Finding all the clues in a level allows you to open a safe with a page from the Thievius Raccoonus which grants a new ability of some sort. After getting this, there is also a master thief sprint where you must get from the start of a level to the exit within a time limit.

Game.Name: Smarties: Meltdown
Game.Overview:
Smarties Meltdown is a third person action adventure, based on the world famous Smarties confection. Smarties Meltdown is set on a giant Smarties shaped 'factory ship' orbiting the Earth. Everything is working smoothly when suddenly the factory ship is attacked by a small armada of craft from the fleet of the evil Dr. Soursweet.
Dr. Soursweet, thwarted by the children of Earth turning their noses up at his own sugary creations the 'stroopers', has decided to take control of the Smarties factory. His sugar coated Stroopers quickly overrun the factory, shutting down production and imprisoning all the Smarties on board. All but one that is.....The Hero Big Blue.

Game.Name: Smash Cars
Game.Overview: No rules radio-controlled racing through living off-road worlds with giant objects, giant animals and giant people. Multiple shortcuts hidden on the tracks make for a more exciting racing and add more intrigue to overcoming opponents. Knocking over and hitting loose objects located on the track allow the player to pick up bonuses

Game.Name: Smash Court Tennis Pro Tournament
Game.Overview: In this officially licensed tennis game from Namco, you can play in all four major tournaments of the tennis season: The Australian Open, Wimbeldon, the French Open and the US Open, with the best players in the world including Andre Agassi, Lleyton Hewitt, Monica Seles and more from the top 8 of both the ATP and WTA tournaments. Single and multiplayer modes are included.

Game.Name: Smash Court Tennis Pro Tournament 2
Game.Overview: The game features many playable modes including Arcade mode and the in depth Pro tour mode in which you create a player and try to become a tennis champion. Other modes include Exhibition, Challenge and Tutorial. There are a range of courts one can play on, including those at the Australian Open (the old Rebound Ace courts), Roland Garros, Wimbledon and the U.S. Open. Along with various tennis characters, players can unlock characters from the Soulcalibur series (Cassandra Alexandra and Raphael Sorel) and Tekken series (Heihachi Mishima and Ling Xiaoyu).

Game.Name: Smuggler's Run
Game.Overview:
Just as the title of the game suggests, you play a smuggler. A smuggler who is carrying either illegal weapons or contraband drugs or a few other kinds of material. Since you have these illegal things in your possession, you are a prime target. A target by law enforcement, a target by rival smugglers and gang, a target by more militaristic forces of the United States.
If you can survive the high speed chases, the off-road evasion, the gunfire and the dust... you stand to make quite a profit. Maybe enough to outfit your vehicle for your next smuggling endeavor. Something that will make the next run a little less hazardous.

Game.Name: Smuggler's Run 2: Hostile Territory
Game.Overview: It is a sequel to the game Smuggler's Run. Like the first game the player is a smuggler trying to deliver illegal cargo to destinations within 3 large maps in the game using several different types of vehicles to make deliveries in a given amount of time.

Game.Name: SNES Station
Game.Overview: This Emulator has allowed to play Super Nintendo Games for Sony PlayStation 2.

Game.Name: Sniper Assault
Game.Overview:
Sniper Assault is a modern war themed single player 3D shooter game played from a third person. The player will take on the role of a soldier deep in enemy territory who has to fight of the bad guys. The game is very similar to Dead Eye Jim.
The game offers several missions in which enemies appear in the windows of towns building or in the background. The player starts the game with three lives and has the ability to doge enemy fire. As the player progresses he can pick up better guns and use these till they are empty and points boxes for the Hi score.

Game.Name: Sniper Elite
Game.Overview:
Sniper Elite is a third-person action strategy game with a focus on sniping. The player takes on the role of an American agent working for the OSS (the organization that later became the CIA) stationed in Berlin at the end of World War II, tasked with preventing the Russian troops from getting hold of the research Germany had been conducting into nuclear weaponry. As an elite sniper, the style of play is much less run-and-gun and much more about finding good positions, lining up shots and taking out the enemy before he even knows where you are.
The single-player campaign takes place over 28 missions set in and around Berlin. Players use stealth tactics, and things like wind and background noise can be a factor when lining up shots. When a shot is performed particularly well, players are rewarded with a 'bullet cam' which follows the bullet in slow-motion from gun barrel to target. It can be played with a friend in local 2-player co-op. Players can revive each other.

Game.Name: SNK Arcade Classics Vol. 1
Game.Overview:
This compilation includes sixteen classic SNK arcade games on a single disc:
- Art of Fighting - Baseball Stars 2 - Burning Fight - Fatal Fury - King of the Monsters - Last Resort - Magician Lord - Metal Slug - Neo Turf Masters - Samurai Shodown - Sengoku - Shock Troopers - Super Sidekicks 3 - The King of Fighters '94 - Top Hunter - World Heroes (unlockable game)
The games are straight-forward arcade ports, with the addition of certain "goals" for the games, which act like achievements. Clearing these goals unlocks hidden features in the disc, such as artwork, music, move lists (for the fighting games) and gameplay videos (which showcase hidden locations within the games.)

Game.Name: SNK NEO-GEO Collection
Game.Overview:
A compilation of various SNK NEO-GEO games. Credits: UsagiRu
Includes the following games:
-SNK ARCADE CLASSICS Vol.1- Art of Fighting Baseball Stars Burning Fight Fatal Fury King of the Monsters Last Resort Magician Lord Metal Slug Neo Turf Masters Samurai Shodown Sengoku Shock Troopers Super Sidekicks 3 The King of Fighters '94 Top Hunter World Heroes
-ADK TAMASHII- Aggressors of Dark Kombat Ninja Masters - Haou Ninpou Chou Ninja Combat Ninja Commando Twinkle Star Sprites
-METAL SLUG ANTHOLOGY- Metal Slug Metal Slug 2 Metal Slug X Metal Slug 3 Metal Slug 4 Metal Slug 5 Metal Slug 6
-SENGOKU ANTHOLOGY- Sengoku Sengoku 2 Sengoku 3
-FUUUN SUPER COMBO*- Savage Reign Kizuna Encounter: Super Tag Battle

Game.Name: SNK Slot Panic Kyuuji
Game.Overview: The player plays as Kyuji, the star ace of the Temjins baseball team. He needs to embark in various training missions to defeat the team's rival, the Black Nines. Players can choose to focus in batting, pitching, or running before playing the big game.

Game.Name: SnoCross 2: Featuring Blair Morgan
Game.Overview: SnoCross 2 features three-time Winter X Games gold winner "Air" Blair Morgan, the most dominant and influential rider in the history of snocross. Punch the throttle and hang on as you blast some insane terrain and push your sled to the limit on serious whoop sections and awesome hills. SnoCross 2 includes over 30 expansive tracks, fully customizable characters, and an amazing trick system that lets you perform jaw-dropping signature moves. Follow the action with first- and third-person adjustable race cam, and between races customize your gear with unlockable sponsor equipment. Design your own courses and share them with friends, and challenge up to 3 other sledheads online.

Game.Name: Snoopy vs The Red Baron
Game.Overview: Snoopy vs. The Red Baron lets players climb into the cockpit to pilot Snoopy's famous Sopwith Camel and other unique aircraft in perilous dogfights, high-speed air races and heart-pounding missions deep behind enemy lines. As players barnstorm across six massive, free-roaming play fields in search of clues for the location of the Red Baron's secret hideout, players can upgrade their aircraft with a collection of 25 unique, comical weapons and other unlockable gadgets, including the player-guided Woodstock missile. Classic Peanuts characters including Charlie Brown, Linus, Lucy, Marcie and Sally will aid Snoopy on his mission, providing him with hints and tips to track down the despicable Red Baron. Features 50+ single-player and co-op missions, action-packed dogfights and customizable planes across six unique environments.

Game.Name: Snowboard Racer 2
Game.Overview: Show no fear as you speed your way down some of the scariest mountains on earth in Snowboard Racer 2. Features include four different characters (and a secret hidden boarder), 12 costumes, four kinds of game modes, and two-player head-to-head support.

Game.Name: Snow Rider
Game.Overview: The snow is falling, the boards are waxed and the slopes are ready - can you become the number one Snow Rider! Take part in 3 exciting game modes, spread across 3 downhill slopes. Can you win the Championship in each mode? And earn yourself the coveted title of Resort Champion?

Game.Name: Snow White and the 7 Clever Boys
Game.Overview: Snow White and the 7 Clever Boys is an Adventure game, developed and published by Phoenix Games, which was released in Europe in 2006.

Game.Name: Soccer America: International Cup
Game.Overview: Soccer America: International Cup (known as International League Soccer in Europe and Greatest Striker in Japan) delivers world-class, real-time soccer action for the PlayStation2 computer entertainment system. Compete in tournaments, exhibition matches, or head-to-head shootouts against rival countries with 36 of the world's best soccer teams. And, with forty-nine different camera positions, Soccer America is the only soccer game to give you a unique television broadcast perspective for thrilling lifelike soccer action.

Game.Name: Soccer Kantoku Saihai Simulation: Formation Final
Game.Overview: Formation Final is a Sports game, published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2003.

Game.Name: Soccer Life!
Game.Overview: Starting as an amateur footballer by training hard and making correct career choices you can gradually become a world famous professional. Apart from the football side of your career you will also be able to manage aspects of your personal life, including friendships and rivalry, dating, marriage and even raising children.

Game.Name: Soccer Life 2
Game.Overview: Soccer Life II combines soccer management, strategy, and player customization into one package.

Game.Name: Soccer Mania
Game.Overview: Soccer Mania is a LEGO-licensed soccer game. Teams are based on characters from LEGO sets. The game takes a more arcade-style approach to soccer, with fast-paced gameplay and power-ups that aid your team. There are five game modes: Quick Start, which starts a game with random teams, exhibition mode, story mode, Skill Zone, which has five tutorials on how to play the game, and LEGO Cup, a World Cup-like mode (suitable for being released in 2002, a World Cup year) where you choose a country and face other countries. You start with only three playable teams, but you unlock each team you defeat in Story Mode and unlock one player each of a special team in each of the six objectives in Skill Zone mode.

Game.Name: SOCOM 3: U.S. Navy SEALs
Game.Overview: The Socom series continues with a single player campaign. 32 player capability is added to the online experience. The series is still about protecting America against urban and rural warfare. Three new AOs are included in this game: Morocco, Poland, and Bangladesh. Maps are 5 to 6 times larger than the last game. Multiple save points have been included. Vehicles can be driven by players and AI. The new weapon customization allows 30 different weapons and attachments. The new TCA system allows the player to quickly give a command.

Game.Name: SOCOM II: U.S. Navy SEALs
Game.Overview: SOCOM II is a third-person tactical shooter. There are 12 different single-player missions: split equally between Albania, Algeria, Brazil and Russia. There are five different ranks that can be played in the game: Ensign, Lieutenant, Commander, Captain and Admiral. The player starts with the first three ranks unlocked, but must finish the single player game on Commander to unlock Captain, and on Captain to unlock Admiral. Players can unlock new models for multiplayer, as well as movies, music, concept art, and credits by completing certain objectives.

Game.Name: SOCOM: U.S. Navy SEALs
Game.Overview:
The player leads a four-man team (three AI-controlled teammates) of United States Navy SEALs through 12 missions in four regions: Alaska, Thailand, Congo, and Turkmenistan in the years 2006 and 2007. In the single player missions, commands can be spoken using the included USB headset or via an onscreen menu if the optional SOCOM headset was not purchased. Typical missions consist of killing terrorists, rescuing hostages, retrieving intelligence, or destroying terrorist bases.
The player character's codename is Kahuna, while the NPC teammates' codenames are Boomer, Spectre and Jester. The team is divided into two sub-groups, Alpha and Bravo. The Alpha group consists of the player and Boomer, while the remaining two make up Bravo. Commands can be issued to both individuals and a whole group, for example it is possible to ask team Bravo to remain stationary while the player is scouting the area with Boomer. However the player can not venture alone through a map, when Kahuna is too far away from Boomer he will automatically resume following the player, regardless of prior orders. Briefings and intel such as maps and photos are given prior to each mission.

Game.Name: SOCOM: U.S. Navy SEALs: Combined Assault
Game.Overview:
SOCOM U.S. Navy SEALs: Combined Assault is a video game for the PlayStation 2 that was released on November 7, 2006 in North America.
Combined Assault's campaign mode offers 18 missions. The game takes place solely in the fictional country of Adjekistan. The country is supposedly situated somewhere in the Afghanistan/Pakistan region of Central Asia, featuring a number of different environment and climate zonesâ€”allowing for the game to feature a wide variety of landscapes and settings while working within one large, connected story. The online servers were shut down on August 31, 2012 Although the Combined Assault servers were shut down, some gamers still play via LAN using programs like Xlink Kai.

Game.Name: Sokudoku Master
Game.Overview: Sokudoku Master is an education game, developed and published by Magnolia, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: Soldier of Fortune: Gold Edition
Game.Overview: Objective: Use any means necessary to find and secure four stolen nuclear warheads. Track and stop the terrorist organization responsible for the theft before they can carry out their threat to national security. Dispatch as many terrorists, skinheads and enemy soldiers as necessary to complete your mission. Failure means more than just going hom in a bag, it could mean global thermonuclear holocaust. And worst of all, you won't get paid. Failure is not an option.

Game.Name: Sol Divide
Game.Overview: Sol Divide delivers players with the action they are looking for and a story that places them right in the heat of the battle in this fantasy-based shooter. With 3 characters to choose from, players will battle their way through various levels in order to beat the evil Iftar who holds the magical sword Sol Divide. With a combination of magic and hand to hand combat, you will be able to defeat Iftar and recover the sacred Spirit Stone.

Game.Name: Sonic Gems Collection
Game.Overview: 9 classic titles from the Sonic the Hedgehog library previously available only in the arcade, on SEGA CD, SEGA Saturn, and Game Gear are now combined into one collection!

Game.Name: Sonic Heroes
Game.Overview: Sonic & the gang, are back in the latest game, SONIC HEROES. Coming out on the Gamecube & for the first time on Playstation 2, Xbox And PC! Sonic Heroes has a twist to the gameplay, you choose a team of 3 characters. With different strengths. There are 4 teams: TEAM SONIC ~ Sonic, Tails & Knuckles TEAM DARK ~ Shadow, Rouge & E-123 Omega TEAM CHAOTIX ~ Espio, Vector, & Charmy Bee TEAM ROSE ~ Amy, Big, & Cream with her Chao sidekick Cheese. There are 4 modes, Story mode, Challenge mode, the Tutorial modes & the new & improved battle mode for multiplayer fun, and there are plenty of secrets to unlock.

Game.Name: Sonic Mega Collection Plus
Game.Overview: Compilation of classic games with the blue hedgehog Sonic. It includes Mega Drive/Genesis classics like Sonic the Hedgehog, Sonic the Hedgehog 2, Sonic the Hedgehog 3, Sonic 3 & Knuckles, Sonic & Knuckles, Knuckles in Sonic 2, Sonic 3D Blast, Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine, six Game Gear games and non-Sonic games.

Game.Name: Sonic Riders
Game.Overview:
In Sonic Riders, Dr. Eggman challenges Sonic and his friends to a Worldwide Grand Prix, and the prize for coming out on top is an ultra-rare Chaos Emerald! Gliding on air boards â€“ which are performance-oriented for each playable character â€“ gamers will experience a heightened sense of sports-style racing tension as Sonic and his pals perform tricks and stunts over treacherous wide-open terrain.
Sonic and friends speed through tracks on air boards, using individual special moves to strike down opponents. Air is a big element of Sonic Riders. Your board's "fuel" source is air. You can fill up your air at various points on the course, but to race well you'll have to use another means of replenishment: performing tricks with your board. You'll also want to make use of turbulence from racers who are in front of you.

Game.Name: Sonic Riders: Zero Gravity
Game.Overview:
Sonic Riders: Zero Gravity is a hoverboard racing video game developed by Sonic Team and published by Sega for the PlayStation 2 and Wii. It is the fifth pure racing game in the Sonic the Hedgehog series, and the second entry in the Sonic Riders trilogy, a spin-off of the main series.
The game received mixed reviews from critics, who praised the graphics, track designs, music and simpler gameplay mechanics compared to the first Riders game, but criticised the controls, story and lack of online multiplayer. A sequel, Sonic Free Riders, was released for the Xbox 360 in 2010. The second in Sonic's racing series takes the hedgehog into never-before seen worlds with edge-of-your-seat racing intensity and all-new gravity controlling moves. In Sonic Riders: Zero Gravity, Sonic takes on to futuristic-inspired tracks and travels as far as outer space to push the limits of speed even further. Two new unique gravity control moves will allow players to outrace opponents while navigating walls, drops, and hairpin turns. Innovative new tracks take full advantage of Sonic's new moves and offer heart-stopping racing action enhanced by high-intensity speed boosts. Sonic Riders: Zero Gravity also features a series of high-speed vehicles that evolve through the gamplay to offer the ultimate unrivaled racing machine.
The Story is split into two halves, the Heroes Story (Team Sonic), and Babylon Story (Babylon Rogues). Although the stories start separately, they overlap each other, telling the story as the main characters within that story see it. Following the format of Sonic Riders, Babylon Story also includes an epilogue that expands past the Heroes Story. Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles are alerted to robots that are attacking a famous city of the future. They set out to retrieve a legendary artifact that has the ability to control gravity. Along the way they discover surprises, including the Babylon Rogues, a group of avian thieves who are also after the artifact. This sets off a war to decide who gets the artifact, leading them to settle their dispute by having an Extreme Gear competition.

Game.Name: Sonic Unleashed
Game.Overview: Having been broken apart by the evil Dr. Eggman, it's up to Sonic to put the pieces of the world back together again by retrieving the power of the chaos emeralds! In doing so, Sonic will find himself in a race against time and faced with an unusual situation that will challenge him in ways never before seen. Both day and night play different, yet important, roles in Sonic's newest quest... as the sun sets, a new adventure awakens.

Game.Name: Son of the Lion King
Game.Overview:
In the jungle everything is as usual. The old lion is a good and wise king, and the animals follow his advice. Only Robin the King's little son doesn't always listen.
Robin wants to find the treasure of the Black Panther but his father has forbidden him to look for it. Keno the son of the Black Panther wants to find the treasure as well. Robin and Keno start out as enemies but end up as best friends.

Game.Name: Sorairo no Organ Remix
Game.Overview: In order to save your cousin, who's been sucked into a mirror, you decide to jump into the mirror yourself. You find yourself in a strange, beautiful world of fairies. As you work through the game's storyline, you'll take part in interactive conversations. The game includes an "encore mode" which allows you to view previous event scenes and listen to music that you encountered on your adventure.

Game.Name: Sorayume
Game.Overview:
Morinaga Satsuki is the only daughter of a family that owns an antique store, with no special redeeming features she is a extremely normal 2nd year high school student. It's the 24th of August, with one week left in her summer vacation. On the day that her parents leave for a purported business trip she spontaneously by chance finds a sparkling yellow ring, "Chrysoberyl".
When Satsuki took that ring and put it on, the man sealed inside was summoned into this world. He called himself a demon called "Ruen Egrandin". He semi-forcefully asked her to help him find the "Thing he was looking for", and as a reward he would grant her a "wish that wasn't particularly a wish".

Game.Name: Soshite Bokura wa, ... and He Said
